source_note: India-specific dispute context: RBI directions and NPCI's UPI dispute framework. Authored summaries with citations, not regulatory text. These entries are context for drafting and for the threat model - they are not scored by the win model, because UPI disputes do not flow through the card-network representment path this system automates.

rules.title: UPI disputes are not card chargebacks
rules.requirement: UPI disputes are resolved through NPCI's dispute management system via the payment service provider, not through card-network representment. The evidence model, deadlines and remedies all differ.
rules.note: Scope boundary. Vakil handles card-network disputes only. A UPI dispute reaching this pipeline should be routed out, not argued - a limitation stated plainly rather than papered over.

citation.document: NPCI UPI dispute and grievance redressal framework

rules.title: Merchants have no equivalent of cardholder protection
rules.requirement: RBI's consumer-protection framework limits customer liability for unauthorised transactions. It creates no matching protection for merchants, who bear the loss unless they successfully contest.
rules.note: This asymmetry is the reason the product exists. The cardholder has a regulator; the merchant has a deadline.

citation.document: RBI - Customer Protection: Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions

rules.title: Return-to-origin and cash-on-delivery context
rules.requirement: Indian ecommerce carries high return-to-origin rates, and delivery documentation quality varies sharply by carrier. Proof-of-delivery scans are often photographs rather than structured records.
rules.note: Why the extraction stage needs a vision model rather than a PDF text parser. See day 5.

citation.document: Razorpay - how payment gateways reduce fraud risk (2026)

rules.title: At least one document is required to contest
rules.requirement: A representment submitted through Razorpay must carry at least one document id across the evidence object's fields. Submitting moves the dispute from open to under_review.
rules.note: Enforced by the mock in vakil.file.mock_razorpay so the filing path fails the same way the real API would.

rules.title: Response deadline
rules.requirement: Each dispute carries a respond_by timestamp. Evidence submitted after it is not considered, and the dispute is lost by default.
rules.note: Enforced in vakil.rules.deadlines, which short-circuits expired disputes before any model call is paid for.
